Glimmer - Double Jump to OoB Ledge.description: Double jump to the out-of-bounds ledge in the area before the cave. You can reach the extended out-of-bounds area and the cave superflight ledge with only charge.

Glimmer - Double Jump to Cave Ledge.description: Double jump to the non-superflight upper ledge in the cave.

Glimmer - Double Jump to Outdoor Ledge.description: Double jump to the upper ledge in the outdoor gem lamps area (where the second and third lizards in 'Lizard hunt' are).

Glimmer - Flamechargejump Outdoor Gem La.description: Flamechargejump the outdoor gem lamps, bypassing the need for superflight.

Glimmer - Outdoor Superflight to Cave Su.description: With precise enough flying, it is possible to fly from the outdoor superflight pyramids, then glide and hover to the cave superflight ledge. Note that flying to the other upper ledge in the cave is considered normal in logic.

Glimmer - Gem Lamp Flight in Cave Withou.description: Light all of the cave gem lamps without superflight, using double jumps. If going in reverse order, you can light the lamp floating over the edge after the bridge and land back on the edge with a precise flame double jump; glide is not required.

Glimmer - Gem Lamp Flight in Cave Orb Cu.description: Use the Orb cutscene for 'Gem Lamp Flight in Cave' to reach the upper superflight ledge.
